name: Reference week
description: Friday has a live quote and confirmed capacity. Monday's quote and capacity first appear on Monday morning.

name: Pre-agreed Monday terms
description: Before Friday's cutoff the provider has agreed Monday forward terms, reserved Monday capacity for a SGD 25.00 fee, and a fallback route is documented.

name: Delayed customer receipt
description: Settled cash is SGD 180,000. A SGD 25,000 customer receipt is forecast for Monday but only settles on Tuesday.

name: Concurrent payout
description: A second supplier payout of SGD 30,000 draws on the same balance before the deadline.

name: Stale Monday quote
description: The only Monday quote known on Friday expires Friday at 18:00 SGT, long before Monday's instruction.

name: Monday closed
description: On Friday morning the provider confirms Monday 16 Nov is not a business day.

name: Low Monday capacity
description: Monday's confirmed payout capacity is only USD 60,000, below the USD 100,000 obligation.

name: Slow last mile
description: The simulated last-mile bound is 9 hours, so a 15:00 SGT release lands after the 23:00 SGT deadline.
